children: Definium Therapeutics announced FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation for DT120 ODT in major depressive disorder following positive Phase 3 results.
FDA granted Breakthrough Therapy designation to DT120 (lysergide) ODT for major depressive disorder to expedite development and review.
Designation supported by Phase 3 Emerge data showing a 100 µg single dose produced an 8.1-point placebo‑adjusted MADRS improvement at Week 6 (p<0.0001).
Durable efficacy observed through Week 12 in the Phase 3 study, reinforcing clinical potential for MDD treatment.
This is DT120’s second FDA Breakthrough designation, adding to prior designation for generalized anxiety disorder and expanding development momentum.
